# The Great Crypto VC Job Board

> Every major crypto VC and Web3 job portal on one page. Browse open roles across 45+ funds and job boards — a16z crypto, Paradigm, Multicoin, Polychain, and more. No more hunting them down one by one.

A free, open-source aggregator that pulls live job postings directly from the career portals of the world's leading crypto venture capital firms and Web3 funds. Updated automatically on a recurring schedule. Built and maintained by [@IshaaqZiyan](https://x.com/IshaaqZiyan).

- **What it does**: Aggregates job listings from the career pages of leading crypto venture capital funds and Web3-focused job boards into a single, searchable interface.
- **Who it's for**: Web3 and crypto job seekers who want to find roles at portfolio companies of top funds without manually checking dozens of sites.
- **Funds tracked**: 45+ top-tier crypto VCs including a16z crypto, Paradigm, Multicoin Capital, Polychain Capital, Pantera Capital, Dragonfly Capital, and more.
- **Data source**: Job data is fetched directly from each fund's public job board feed (e.g. Getro-powered boards). No scraping of individual company pages.
- **Update cadence**: Listings are refreshed automatically via GitHub Actions. Visitors can also trigger a manual refresh from the Jobs page.
- **Tech stack**: Built with Astro, deployed on the Internet Computer (ICP), served via custom domain cryptovcjobs.ishaaq.org.
- **Open source**: Full codebase at [ishaaqziyan/VC-Job-Board](https://github.com/ishaaqziyan/VC-Job-Board) on GitHub.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cryptovcjobs.ishaaq.org/): Landing page with an overview of the platform, links to live job postings, and a preview of the tracked crypto VC fund directory.
- [Jobs](https://cryptovcjobs.ishaaq.org/jobs): Browse live, filterable job postings pulled from 45+ crypto VC and Web3 job boards. Supports search by role, company, or location with a remote-only toggle. Data is refreshed automatically and can be triggered manually.
- [Job Boards](https://cryptovcjobs.ishaaq.org/job-boards): Full directory of all tracked crypto VC and Web3 job boards. Includes funds with and without machine-readable feeds. Searchable by fund name.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://cryptovcjobs.ishaaq.org/sitemap-index.xml): XML sitemap for all pages on the site.
